block.spikyspikes.diamond_spike.descript: Killed mobs drop all loot like when killed by a player. Accepts most sword enchantments.

block.spikyspikes.iron_spike.description: 被殺死的生物只會掉落一般戰利品，而不會掉落經驗。
block.spikyspikes.netherite_spike.descri: Killed mobs drop all loot like when killed by a player. Accepts most sword enchantments. Resistant to explosions and the wither boss. Does not damage players.
block.spikyspikes.stone_spike.descriptio: 被殺死的生物不會掉落任何戰利品或經驗。
block.spikyspikes.wooden_spike.descripti: 會緩慢地對生物造成傷害，但不會給予致命一擊。
